module.purpose: Provides the default React canvas composition for the editor, wiring editor state, pointer and gesture handling, shape rendering, culling, overlays, background components, and debug visualization into the canvas DOM.
module.summary: This module assembles the editor's primary canvas and its surrounding layers. It subscribes to reactive editor state to update DOM data attributes, text-outline styles, camera transforms, grid visibility, rendered shapes, and culling. It also installs document and pointer event hooks, renders configurable components, handles Safari-specific reflow behavior, and optionally generates asynchronous SVG previews for rendered shapes.
module.businessContext: This is the presentation boundary for an interactive drawing editor. If it fails, canvas rendering, input handling, overlays, shape visibility, and editor interaction feedback break.
functions: DefaultCanvas (~L33-156): Composes the editor canvas, layers, overlays, and configurable components.
InFrontOfTheCanvasWrapper (~L158-172): Renders optional content above the canvas and handles pointer events.
GridWrapper (~L174-182): Reads camera and document settings to render the grid.
ShapesLayer (~L184-204): Renders visible shapes, debug copies, and culling controls.
ReflowIfNeeded (~L205-224): Forces Safari layout reflow when culled shapes change.
CullingController (~L228-241): Synchronizes editor culled shapes with the culling provider.
DebugSvgCopy (~L243-323): Asynchronously renders a root shape as an SVG preview.
OnTheCanvasWrapper (~L325-329): Renders optional content positioned on the canvas.
MovingCameraHitTestBlocker (~L331-341): Blocks canvas hit testing while the camera moves.

env: Reads tlenv.isSafari to select Safari-specific rendering and reflow behavior.

function InFrontOfTheCanvasWrapper() {
	const editor = useEditor()
	const { InFrontOfTheCanvas } = useEditorComponents()
	if (!InFrontOfTheCanvas) return null
	return (
		<div
			className="tl-canvas__in-front"
			onPointerDown={editor.markEventAsHandled}

			onTouchStart={editor.markEventAsHandled}
			onTouchEnd={editor.markEventAsHandled}

detail.name: DebugSvgCopy
detail.signature: function DebugSvgCopy({ id, mode }: { id: TLShapeId; mode: 'img' | 'iframe' })
preconditions: The component is rendered within an editor context providing useEditor().
postconditions: If the shape is not a child of the current page, or no SVG image has been generated, the function renders null.
For mode 'iframe', the generated SVG data URL is rendered in an absolutely positioned iframe using the calculated bounds.
For mode 'img', the generated SVG data URL is rendered in an img element using the calculated bounds.
Only the latest asynchronous SVG-generation result may update the displayed image.
invariants: A shape identified by id is considered eligible only when its parentId equals the editor's current page id.
Frame-like shapes use zero padding; other shapes use padding 10.
SVG output is encoded as a data:image/svg+xml;utf8 URL before being rendered.
Unmounting or dependency changes invalidate the current render token and unsubscribe from the shape-to-SVG event.
edgeCases: When the shape is not in the current page root, no SVG generation subscription is established and null is rendered.
When getShapePageBounds(id) returns no bounds, the event handler exits without updating image state.
When SVG generation returns no result, image state is not updated.
When an older asynchronous SVG result completes after a newer render has started, the older result is ignored.
When mode is 'iframe', the copy is positioned below the source bounds using a 12 pixel vertical offset; otherwise an img element is rendered.

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: No explicit validation is performed; inputs outside the declared mode and id contract are not specified.
errorPolicy.returnsOnError: Returns null when the shape is not in the current page root or when no image has been generated; missing bounds or an empty SVG result leave the existing image unchanged.

stateMutations: Updates local image state with the generated SVG data URL and expanded bounds.
detail.ioFormatSpec: Produces either an img or iframe element whose source is a data:image/svg+xml;utf8 URL containing encodeURIComponent(result.svg). Both elements use image.bounds.width and image.bounds.height; the iframe additionally uses referrerPolicy="no-referrer", absolute positioning, border none, transform translate(${image.bounds.x}px, ${image.bounds.maxY + 12}px), outline 1px solid black, and maxWidth none.
detail.summary: Renders a debug SVG copy of a root-level shape as either an image or an iframe. It keeps the displayed SVG synchronized with shape-to-SVG events while discarding stale asynchronous render results.
